name: Mind Crush
source:
Europe in the early 1900s. Small poor country is sandwiched between three enemy states.
Main character is from such country. In order for his country to survive he decides to train women as sexual slaves and provide them to high-ranking officials of neighboring countries.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
20世纪初的欧洲，一个贫穷小国夹在三个敌对国家之间。
主人公就来自这个国家。为了让祖国生存下去，他决定把成年女性训练成性奴隶，并将她们献给邻国高官。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
